- Moving goods using an EPT

- Travel allowance of €0.17 per kilometer
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower
    
- Working week of 24 to 40 hours
    
- Varied logistics-related tasks
    
- Opportunity to gain experience in an international working environment
    
- Possibility of long-term employment

    - Willingness to work different shifts
    
- Good command of the Dutch and English language, both spoken and written
    
- Ability to understand English systems and instructions
    
- Accurate and safety-conscious working attitude
    
- Good physical condition
    
- Reliable and responsible mindset
    
- Own transportation or a driving licence due to the accessibility of the location
